additional_info.subject: RE: ID0374476-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/R6 313053966019] SCB Connection problem CRM:00579001023
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr.Yunus,
Hope you are doing well
Due to the absence of an SCB connection, our ability to provide remote support is currently limited. To proceed, it would be ideal to have someone on-site to check the following:
Ensure that the router is connected to the internet.
Verify that the charger is powered on.
Additionally, please consider the following potential reasons for the charger being offline:
Internet Issues
:
There may be an issue with the Siemens router, possibly due to the WAN switching from Cellular to Ethernet because of a failover function.
I recommend performing a hard reset via OCPP (if the charger is connected to an OCPP server) or initiating a local reboot to restore functionality.
Mobile Network Issues
:
The data service of the mobile network operator might be unavailable.
The SIM card could be disabled or expired. Please clean and reinsert the SIM card into the XF3 and XF4 routers to ensure proper connectivity.
The monthly data volume may be exhausted.
Signal strength could be weakened due to changes in radio transmission conditions.
For M2M contracts, the IP might not be enabled.
Backend Issues
:
There may have been changes in the backend settings for the affected charger.
The OCPP server on the backend side might be unavailable.
Teltonika Router Issues
:
The router might have switched to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
The router may have experienced hardware failure.
There could be a software crash in the router.
For future reference, please use the ticket number ID0374476 in all further communications regarding this issue.
Thank you for your time and understanding. We appreciate your cooperation.
Best regards,
Abhinav Malokar
eMobility Tech Support Team
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
